items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: He was going to record for Clarence Williams and he asked me to record with him, so I did it.

ctx.x: I notice that after you -- According to the discography of the French doctor, you recorded with King Oliver after you were with Duke. How did that come about?
Oh, well, he didn't have any band anymore and I knew the things that he was going to record. He was going to record for Clarence Williams and he asked me to record with him, so I did it.
